description: A quick self-assessment that places a guitarist on Fretwork's 10-stage learning path (Stage 0 Getting Started to Stage 9 Artistry) from yes/no answers to up to nine questions about what they can already play, and says what to learn next. The questions build on each other, so answers are read in order up to the first "no". Called with no answers, it returns the nine questions.

barre_chords_and_16th_groove.description: Can you play any major or minor barre chord and hold a 16th-note strumming groove?

bends_vibrato_full_solo.description: Can you play a solo with in-tune bends, vibrato and clear phrases?

change_chords_in_time.description: Can you change between basic open chords (like G, C, D, Em) in time and play a whole simple song?

four_chord_song_with_pattern.description: Can you play a four-chord song start to finish with a strumming pattern?

keys_and_pentatonic_anywhere.description: Can you name the chords in any key and solo with the pentatonic scale anywhere on the neck?

play_the_changes.description: Can you solo over a progression and target the chord tones as the chords change?

riff_blues_and_short_solo.description: Can you play a riff, a 12-bar blues and a short solo of your own?

transcribe_and_tension.description: Can you transcribe a full solo and improvise with tension and release?

tune_and_clean_notes.description: Can you tune the guitar and play a clean note on every string?

name: guitar_level_check
title: Check a guitarist's level
